title: The Sweet Tide
author: Ada Villalobos
blurb: Lior Kavanagh, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
